text.p: WorldCorp said on Tuesday that its board has appointed Walter Fiederowicz, former chairman of Colonial Data Technologies Corp, as its president and chief executive officer.
Colonial Data merged with US Order Inc in a deal that was was completed in November, creating InteliData Technologies Corp, in which WorldCorp owns a 29 percent stake.

Fiederowicz succeeds Coleman Andrews, who was elected WorldCorp chairman, the company said. Andrews succeeds William Gorog, who was elected chairman of the executive committee of the WorldCorp board, it said.
Fiederowicz also serves as director of First Albany Cos, Photronics Inc and InteliData, WorldCorp said.
InteliData provides proudcts and services for the financial services and telecommunications servces.

WorldCorp also holds a 62 percent stake in World Airways, a global passenger and cargo air transporation company. The other owners of World Airways are MSH Berhad of Malaysia, which holds a 18 percent stake and public investors, who own the remaining 20 percent.
